recognized_behavior: wheel artifacts are confined to the existing workspace directory dist

rules.decision: allow recursive writes only in the explicitly declared output directory
rules.rationale: the command names an existing workspace directory as --wheel-dir; the grant is limited to that directory and its descendants

unresolved_requirements: the selected PEP 517 or legacy build backend is not analyzed and may be denied if it writes inside the readonly workspace
dependencies and build isolation are disabled; all undeclared backend inputs must already exist in the guest runtime
